༄༅/ /'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i sgrub dbang khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston gyi gsal byed zin bris bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i sgrub dbang khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston gyi gsal byed zin bris bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ bla ma dang 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir tshe bdag sgrub dbang chen mor grags pa khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston gyi steng nas ji ltar bskur ba'i dbang dngos kyi gsal byed zin bris rje'i gsung bzhin bri ba la/ dang po slob ma sta gon skabs mtshams bcad bzhi po byed dgos/ bsdus par na badz+ra rak+ṣas kyang rung*/ gang ltar mtshams bcad kyi sa khul ma stong tsam nges par dgos/ bsgo ba la gsol gdab lan gcig gis chog khrus chu yang khang pa'i 'gags phyi nas gtong sdom gyi tshigs bcad skabs/ khrus bskrad gsol drang phyag bya gsol// zhes pa la dpe cha ma dag rgyun 'byams pas phyag rgya zhes bris pa ni nor ba ste/ phyag bya ba'i don yin/ de yang las rdor gyi 'gags nas chab btang bsgo bas sgo phyes slob dpon gyi drung du sleb zhor nas slob mas phyag 'tshal ba gzhir bcas pa'i phyir de la dgongs kyi 'don cha sogs dang dmigs pa ni gang yang mi dgos/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul mtshams mi gsal yang*/ ho bstan pa'i sgron me bcom ldan 'das// zhes pa'i gsol btab kyi mgo der sta dngos gnyis ka la yin/ gsol gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// sogs kyi thun mong sems bskyed gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po dang*/ rang byin rlabs pa'i sogs nas/ bo dhi tsit+ta a dra u pa da ya mi bar gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis kyi sdom pa bzung ba/ rnam rtog ye shes lngar gyur pa sogs kyis rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bya ba yin gyi/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor cher// rigs lnga'i sdom pa 'di yis blangs// sogs bris pa ni/ kun mkhyen chen po dang rang gi bla ma gnyis ka'i dgongs pa ma lon bzhin du tshig bcos nas bris pa'i slob ma rnams kyi rmongs blo'o// yig brgya dpon slob chabs cig tu gsum lnga bdun sogs gang rung brjod/ badz+ra dang badz+ra sa twa gar yod la ya man+ta ka bcug la bzla'o// so shing dor ba'i tshom bu 'bru'i tshom bu lnga chung chung rang min pa zhig bkod pa la/

tshoms bu lnga po 'di nyid rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du shes pas de la dngos grub kyi pra brtag pa'i phyir so shing dor ba zhu sogs lta bu'i tshig gang 'os blo nas spros te brjod pa ma gtogs rigs lnga'i mngon rtags sku mdog dang zhal phyag lta bu'i dmigs pa byed mi dgos/ mchod bstod dang dam ye bsre ba dam ye dbyer med kyi ngo bor mos pa sogs kyang mi dgos/ slob mas 'dor tshul lag g.yas g.yon gyi mdzub mo rnams dang mthe bong mtho 'jal stabs su brkyang ba kha sbyor du byas pa'i mthe bong dang gung mo gnyis kyi bar du so shing bzung nas// rtsa ba so la drud pa dang*/ rtse mo sos 'cha' tshul byed pa sogs bshad tshod gang yin dang bstun pas 'dor ba'o// de yang so shing*/ khyor chu/ ku sha srung skud thams cad la byin rlabs kyi sngags bsgrags rgyu re dang*/ las chus bsangs ba re nges par yod pa sku zhabs rje dbon gyi zin bris la de kun dbang sgrub skabs nas bya bar gsungs kyang*/ so so'i dus der byin rlabs byas nas sprod pa rdo rje slob dpon rnams kyi phyag bzhes la yod pa ltar legs pas/ de ltar na 'dir yang las chus bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li bdun phrag tsam bla mas bsgrang*/ des rigs 'gres te khyor chu bsangs/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sogs tshar bdun bgrang*/ ku sha bsangs/ oṃ ni med/ badz+ra tik+ṣa ṇa baṃ tshar bdun bgrang*/ srung skud bsangs/ e myags la hūm̐ phaṭ btags pa nyer gcig bsgrang*/ 'di la mdud pa gsum byas phu yang rgyag dgos zhes gong ma tshor mi dgos/ de thams cad so so la 'dun pa gtod nas sngags bsgrang ba tsam las dmigs pas dbyibs rnams su bsgom rgyu ni cang med/ dpung par bcings zin nas mdud mtshams su mdzub rtse'am las bum kha rgyan gyi rtsa bas dri thig dang*/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas gdab rnams bya/ sta gon gi mjug tu gtang rag maṇ+ḍal byed pa dang mi byed pa'i lugs gnyis yod par gnyis kar phyag bzhes kyi khyad par re ni yin kyang*/

mi byed pa nyid legs pa yin gsungs/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ khrus bskrad gsol grangs phyag bya gsol// spro bskyed nyan gdams sems gnyis sdoms// sta gon ji bzhin 'dir yang ngo*// zhes gsungs pas gzim chung 'gags nas bsgo ba la gsol gdab dri lan dngos su 'grub na dang*/ de min kyang*/ de dag mos pas byar gzhug ste ji ltar bltams pa'i khrus nas/ byang chub sems gnyis kyi sdom bzung*/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po dang sogs lan gsum pa'i mtha'/ a dra u pa da ya mi bar sta gon ji lta ba bzhin du gtong*/ dang po'i man+ḍal yang*/ ho bstan pa'i sgron me'i mgor 'bul zhing*/ de la bla ma dang 'jam dpal zil gnon chen po dbyer ma mchis pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug cing dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi zhes 'don/ mig dar 'ching rgyu thams cad la dpon slob gnyis ka'am/ yang na bla mas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes nges par brjod dgos/ man+ḍal gnyis pa la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i yon du zhes 'don/ sta dngos gnyis ka la 'dra ste lag gi rdo rje la 'chang nas nang du 'jug pa'i mos pa bya rgyu yod tshad la/ slob dpon phyag gi rdo rjer slob mas lag pa reg tsam byed du 'jug dgos/ rjes zlos dgos rigs grangs ka dmigs bsal med pa tshor gsol gdab gal che snyam pa 'dug na tshar gsum re dang*/ dri ba dri lan lta bu gnad chung rigs la tshar res chog pa babs bltas te rig pas dpyod/ slob ma'i dris lan/ brtul zhugs chen po bla na med pa/ mthar lam phyin pa spyod par 'tshal/ zhes pa dag dgongs gsol la/ slob dpon gyis ni dkyil 'khor lhar// zhes gsungs rgyu yin 'dug pas/ dgongs gsol dngos lha dang sogs tshig rkang gsum las ma byung*/ sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya sor mo kun bsnol nas de 'grol ba dang sbrags dbye tshul byed pa dang*/ srin lag mthe'u chung gnyis bkug pa'i rtse mo'i phyi ngos nas mthe bong bkug pas mnan/

mdzub mo dang gung mo gnyis brkyang bas dbye tshul byed pa gnyis ka sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya yin pa gang byas kyang mi 'gal/ phyag bya ba ni phyogs bzhi char la 'dra ste/ mnyam nyid dag pa'i tshul sogs/ tshigs rkang gcig kho na lan bzhir ldab pas so// skabs 'di'i bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa/ yab yum rtsa ba'i lha bzhi nas/ 'khor dang bcas pa zhal mngon sum du khra hram mer bzhugs pa sogs gsungs pa dang*/ gsham gyi lha ngo ston pa gnyis zlos pa ltar byung zhing*/ dgongs gsol sgo dbye phyag lha bstan// zhes lha ston pa'i brda chad kyang sbyar bar mdzad mod kyi/ don du 'dir ni khang pa 'di'i nang du mi 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba rnams yod do// zhes ming tsam ston pa dang*/ 'og tu mi 'di ni 'di yin/ 'di ni 'di zhes bya ba zhig go /zhes mdzub mo btsugs te ngo sprod pa lta bu yin pas de la ni nges don gyi dag sbyor dang bcas te ston pa yin/ de'i phyir mig dbye gsol dbye lha ngo sprad// zhes ngo sprad pa'i tha snyad mdzad pa'i khyad par ro// slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis rlabs pa/ mdzod spu'i dbus nas 'od zer dkar po dang*/ mgul gyi nas dmar po/ thugs ka'i dbus nas sngon po sogs sbrel te 'don pa ma gtogs/ ye shes dbab pa dngos ma yin pas bar mtshams su spos rol mi dgos/ maṇ+ḍal gsum pa la ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du zhes 'don/ ā+oṃ byang gyi ā+oṃ 'od du zhu ba slob ma'i lus la thim pa'i rkyen gyis stong par sbyangs/ de'i ngang las slob ma lhar bskyed dus kyi mngon rtogs/ rgyu med klu 'bum gnyen khri sa bdag stong*// nas/ gshan pa khrag skyug dregs pa kun gyis bskor bar las byang bzhin btags kyang mi rung ba med mod/ e ring ji ltar brjod zhes gsung pas/ a+ye ring bsnyen pa'i man ngag bzhin gtong na yang rgyu dang rkyen med par nas gnas gsum byin rlabs bar mthar chags su btang bas lha tshogs yongs rdzogs bskyed pa yin gyi 'dor len dgos pa gang yang med/

slob ma mang na byin 'bebs dngos gzhir rol chen re nges par byed/ slob ma gcig pu'am nyung ngu las med cing spros med kyi skabs yin na'ang*/ spos bdug slob dpon gyis ḍā dril bya/ mthar yongs grags yin pas gzhan gyi rigs 'gre shes 'gyur du dgongs/ dngos gsal mi 'dug kyang tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya zhing*/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram 'jog pa de nges par dgos// me tog 'dor sa dkyil 'khor dngos la byed na yang ras bris lta bu la ni rung*/ rdul tshon yin na lha mtshan zub par 'gyur ba'i nyes pa 'byung ba 'gog pa'i phyir/ steng nas ma reg par dar la seng lta bu phyi nang mi sgrib pa zhig bkab pa la/ me tog dor bas lha'i mtshan ma mi sub cing gang la phog pa ngos zin pa'i dgos pa yod pas/ rig bzo'i lag len yin kyang don dang mi 'gal bas byed du rung ba ma zad legs pa yin yang dkyil 'khor dngos la mi 'dor na yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gzhan zhig la 'dor ba'i lugs kyang yod/ de min stegs bu'am maṇ+ḍal la lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod lcog na dang*/ gzhan maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad la 'bru'i tshom bu'am/ rigs lnga'i mtshan ma'am/ bum mtshan nam/ rigs brtags shing gsang mtshan 'dogs pa la phan pa'i lha tshogs kyi gtso bo lnga'am dgu'i phyag mtshan sogs gang rung bkod pa yin/ 'di ni so shing 'dor sa la yang 'dra/ 'on kyang de la lha bskyed mchod bstod bzlas pa rnams byed srol med/ de yang phyogs shar la sogs pa'i rjes 'brang mtshams shar lho sogs rim pas yin phyir mtshan ma ma bkod kyang*/ mtshams gang la me tog phog pa de'i rigs shes par 'gyur bas/ phyogs bzhi lte ba dang bcas par bkod gzhan la ma bkod na lnga dang*/ mtshams rnams su'ang bkod pas dgur 'gyur ba yin/ de la dgur byed pa spro na yang*/ rigs lnga'i mtshan ma dgod na/ shar dang shar lhor rdo rje nas/

byang dang byang shar ral gri'i bar dang*/ lha tshogs kyi gtso bo'i phyag mtshan dgod na/ lte bar gtso bo'i phyag mtshan 'khor lo bkod/ yum rnams la me tog phog kyang rigs ngos 'dzin rgyu dang*/ ming 'dogs rgyu log pa med pas/ yum gsum gyi phyag mtshan 'god mi dgos shar du phyag rdor gyi phyag mtshan rdo rje/ lhor gshin rje'i phyag mtshan 'khor lo/ nub tu ru sbal la mchod rten/ byang du bya khyung la sbrul rnams dang*/ mtshams rnams su gyad gnon gyi phyag mtshan ral gri rnams 'god pa yin kyang phal cher snga ma bzhin legs/ dus 'khor las ni rnam rgyal bum pa'i khar man+ḍal la bum mtshan dgu bkod nas 'dor ba yang gsung*/ de rnams gang la yin kyang 'dra ste/ dkyil 'khor dngos la dor ba las gzhan pa kun la rgya gar lugs kyi phyag len phyis dar la/ lha'i mtshan ma lnga'am dgu po gang yin de la lha so so'i mtshan tsam slob dpon gyis smos te slob mar skad cig gis gsal 'debs su bcug pa'i dam tshig par dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang de'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba re chad de byon pa'i ye shes pa bsre ba'am/ yang na thog ma nas dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa'i ngo bor gsal 'debs su bcug pa la/ ya man+ta ka sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pād+yaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar dang*/ lha'i rgyal po'am chos kyi dbyings nas go 'byed sogs gang rung shwa lo kas bstod/ a kro te ka sogs e thung brgya phrag nas bdun gyi bar gang rung bzla ba'o// bod rnying pa'i phyag len grub mtha' yongs grags la ni/ lhar bskyed mchod bstod sngags bzla ba sogs de rnams mi mdzad pa yin/ de nas me tog 'dor du gzhug dus rang rigs kyi lha ma brjed par zungs shig ces gdams/ me tog spyi bor 'jog dus gang la phog pa'i sngags brjod ces gsungs pa ltar na/ gtso bo la phog na gtso sngags/ phyag rdor la phog na/ phyag rdor gyi sngags/ mtshams rnams su phog na gyad gnon gyi sngags kyi bar 'don bzhin spyi bor 'ching rgyu yin kyang*/

phal cher bshad tshod bzhin mi 'grub pa shas che bas e thung rang bsgrang kyang chog me tog 'dor ba'i sngags gzhung nas bshad ltar la slob ma mang por byed dus sngags ring ba ma lcog na/ puṣ+pe sa ma ya pū dza ho/ zhes pa tsam gyis chog lha ngo ston tshul rgyas par spro na dag sbyor sogs phyag rgya gsal sgron las len/ man+ḍal lnga pa la bla ma sku rin po che'i rdo rje'i bdag nyid can gyi drung du lus kyi sgrib pa sbyangs shing sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa 'jog pa bum pa'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du 'bul ba bgyi zhes 'don/ rin chen dngul gyi bum pa sogs kyi mjug khrus byas sdig sgrib dag par bsam/ zhes pa'i skabs swa bhā wa brjod/ las bum gyi chu 'thung du gzhug ku shas las bum gyi chu gtor mgo bor bzhag ni mi dgos/ ming dbang skabs gsang ming 'dogs dgos te/ de yang sngar me tog gang la phog pa yin dris te/ de dang bstun pa'i ming 'dogs tshul/ rje btsun dam pa tā ra nā thas rdo rje phur pa'i dbang gi skabs/ rnying ma rang lugs kyi rdo rje thod phreng rtsal sogs rigs lnga dang*/ mi 'gyur lhun grub/ mi ldog yang dag dri med/ grub pa rnams la rtsal gyi mtha' can du dbye ba sogs kyang 'dug cing*/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i mtshan rtags kyang legs pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir yang ste/ de yang dper na me tog shar lta bu la phog na rdo rje mi 'gyur rtsal nas/ rdo rje grub pa rtsal gyi bar dang*/ bud med la lho dang nub tu me tog phog na/ rin chen myu gu dang*/ pad+ma myu gu zhes kyang 'dogs pa'i srol snang*/ gzhan chags pa rdo rje dang gti mug rdo rje sogs kyang*/ don du 'dogs rung tsam du ma zad bshad tshod kyang de ga yin mod kyi/ rnam pa ming mi snyan pas/ blun po 'ga' re ma dga' ba byed kyi dogs/ deng sang de ltar 'dogs pa nyung ba yin/ yang skabs 'dir ni dbus su phog pa'i rigs la/

'jam dpal/ zil gnon/ snang mdzad/ rnam snang sogs sbyor/ rigs lnga ka la bzhad pa/ dga' ba/ dgyes pa sogs kyang sbyar na legs pa yin gsungs/ ye shes lha dbang gi mgor/ gtso bo lus dkyil bzhin du bsgom/ zhes par sgoms lugs zin bris zur du yod pa ltar shes par bya'o// tsa ka li'i lha dbang slob ma mang ba dang*/ mdor bsdus kyi skabs bstod pa kha bsgyur gyi mthar so so'i sngags la a bhi ṣiñca maṃ btags pas bskur/ slob ma nyung zhing spro na/ rgyas 'dod re res bskur ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mu tig 'phreng ba sogs len 'os pa nas kyang blang ba'am/ tsa ka li'i rgyab byang bzhin lha re dang bskur tshig shwa lo ka re tsa ka li re rnams sbrags nas bskur ba yin/ rdo rje'i dri thig dgos tshad ni slob dpon lag gis rdo rje'i rtse mos so// brjid pa dpa' bo'i bro chen dang*/ dgyes pa dpa' mo'i glu dbyangs kyi skabs/ sngon tshe bsod nams bsags pa dang*/ a+ye myags 'bru brgyad kyi dzb dbyangs dang*/ dang po'i sangs rgyas sogs dbyangs dang bcas pas brjod bzhin slob ma tshos dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' la bskor ba dngos su'am mos pa bya/ de'i dus su dkyil 'khor pa'i lha'i thugs ka nas drag sngags kyi char chen po byung ba slob ma rang rang gi ngag la thim pa'i mos pa byar gzhug dgos kyang*/ sngags kyi bzlas lung dngos ni gsham de ma thag nas rim pas 'byung ba rnams yin no// maṇ+ḍal drug pa la/ bla ma gsung rdo rje'i bdag nyid can gyi drung du ngag gi dri ma sbyangs zhing gsung rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa 'jog pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon zhes 'don/ gnyis med brtul zhugs chen po la sogs e ka ya ma sogs kyi skabs/ bla ma'i byang sems dkar char mos pas thod chang tshar gcig dang*/ yang bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ sogs kyis skabs kyang*/ yum gyi byang sems dmar char mos pas thod chang tshar gcig tu lan gnyis sbyin dgos/

'di nas mig dar dkrol/ rak+ta dang gtor ma'i bskur tshig chos kyi dbyings go 'byed sogs bstod pa'i shwa lo ka dang po kha bsgyur ba'am lha'i rgyal po lha mchog sogs kyis lha dbang gi gtso tsa ka bzhin du bskur na yid la bde mdog kha ba zhig snang yang*/ kun mkhyen chen po rang gis/ rak+ta gtor ma mchod pa'i tshig /dbang bskur 'don pa bsgyur la bskur// zhes gsungs par ma zad/ lugs gzhan gyi dbang la yang rak+ta dang gtor ma'i bskur tshig 'dir bshad pa bzhin du 'dug pas dwangs ma snying khrag dang*/ phyi snod 'jig rten sogs kyi shwa lo ka'i tshig mtha' dbang bskur ro zhes bsgyur bas bskur/ rak+ta la sngags e ka ya ma gu ye rak+ta bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca ho/ zhes brjod nas lag par gtad pa dang*/ gtor ma la e ka ya ma ba liṃ dz+nyā na pū dza a bhi ṣiñca ho/ zhes 'don bzhin du dbang gtor mgo bor 'jog pa yin/ mgo rlon ga shal sbyin pa'i tshigs bcad dpe la lar yod/ la lar med pa zhig snang ba re zhig yod pa'i lugs su byas na legs pas/ de lta na tshigs bcad snga ma thod skam gyi dbu rgyan lnga po g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing gi zhal gsum po re re la yang tshar re yod pa la dgongs nas tshar gsum zhes brda chad sbyor bar mdzad 'dug pa ltar na/ tsa ka li sogs la'ang de bzhin 'bri dgos pa 'dra/ 'on kyang rnying ma sogs spyi grags thams cad la thod pa tshar gsum zer na mi mgo skam rnying rlon gsum las 'os med pas skabs 'dir yang ji ltar yin da dung brtag dgos par snang ngo*// tshe gal spyi bor dang*/ tshogs lag par bskur/ maṇ+ḍal bdun pa la/ bla ma'i thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid can gyi drung du/ yid kyi dri ma sbyangs shing thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa 'jog pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du zhes 'don/ dri lan gyi rigs dbang 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum du yod pa kun la rjes zlos byar gzhug

gzung ma la spro ba 'dri bar man dmigs gsal bshad pa mi 'dug kyang*/ spro zhes khas blangs par mos dgos/ 'di las mchog tu gzhan med do nas mig dar dkrol/ man+ḍal brgyad pa dbang bzhi pa'i man+ḍal 'bul mtshams mi gsal yang*/ na mo/ che ba'i nang nas che ba'i mchog /sogs kyis gsol gdab kyi gong der 'bul ba yin pas de la/ bla ma ngo bo nyid sku'i bdag nyid can gyi drung du lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs shing*/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa 'jog pa dbang bzhi pa tshigs dbang rin po che zhu ba'i yon du zhes 'don/ drag po mthu yi dbang bskur gyi// brub khung thod nang liṅga bcug /zhes pa'i skabs dbang rgyas pa spros bcas 'chams sogs dang 'brel ba yin na/ las byang gi bsgral las stabs pa dang bcas byas kyang 'gal ba med cing legs pa yin/ gzhan brub khung bskyed chog bya/ bden brdar 'gugs gzhug tshar gsum nas/ thugs rje thabs kyi sbyor ba sogs kyis phur pa btab/ gdug pa can gyi dgra bgegs la// sogs sngags dang bcas pas liṅga phur pa dang sbrags pa lag tu bzhag ste dbang bskur/ slar yang liṅga slob ma'i gtso bo'i mdun du bkod/ thun gyi dbang ni lag g.yas su yungs kar dang khrag thun sogs rdzas yongs rdzogs dang*/ g.yon du rak+sha gtad de drag po'i sngags sogs tshigs bcad brjod/ thun sngags ni/ yungs kar rgyal po'i gsham gyi e ka he dun trag rak+sha ya ya ma rā dza sa do me ya ya me do ru sogs yin/ yang thun rnams kyang slob ma'i gtso bo mdun du bkod de/ rgyas par spro na/ thun so so'i tshigs bcad las byang ltar len pas sam/ bsdu na thun sngags kho nas rim bzhin rdeg tu gzhug zor dbang bskur rgyu dbang rdzas la/ dmar gtor ni mi dgos/ byas kyang mi rung ba ni med/ gtor ma yod phyin skabs der 'phen du gzhug gzhan 'ur rdo sogs zor rdzas tshang ma dgos pa yin no// zor sngags ni bzlog bsgyur/
dus gsum sangs rgyas spyi gzugs pa// sogs kyi gsham e ka he dun bh+yo bzlog sogs so// gsham du gtso bos ji ltar dang*/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran sogs kyang dgos gsungs/

de ltar na 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i sgrub dbang khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston gyi lag len mi bde ba'i 'phrang sel 'di'ang rje thams cad mkhyen pa chen po bka' brgyud 'phrin las shing rta'i bka' drin las byung ba brjed thor bkod pa maṅga laṃ bistā ra ku ru/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
